buttons.label: Stage actors
buttons.script: const all=[...objects];for(const a of all){if(a.definition?.id?.startsWith('discipline-')){if(a.enemyType==='CinderImp')a.testPlayClip('idle');else if(a.enemyType==='FrostPuff')a.testClip='hover_idle';else a.testPlayClip('idle');a.entity.rigidbody.teleport(a.definition.position.x,a.definition.position.y,a.definition.position.z);}}const crab=all.find(a=>a.definition?.id==='discipline-crab');crab.revengeTarget=all.find(a=>a.definition?.id==='discipline-rival');

buttons.label: Both sources cast
buttons.script: for(const a of objects){if(a.enemyType==='MaskShaman')a.testClip=null;}

buttons.label: Pause both sources
buttons.script: for(const a of objects){if(a.enemyType==='MaskShaman')a.testClip='idle';}

buttons.label: Interrupt first source
buttons.script: for(const a of objects){if(a.definition?.id==='mask-shaman-main')a.onBellRung({duration:5});}

buttons.label: Move second out of range
buttons.script: for(const a of objects){if(a.definition?.id==='mask-shaman-ally')a.entity.rigidbody.teleport(4,2.08,4);}

buttons.label: Release rivals
buttons.script: for(const a of objects){if(a.definition?.id?.startsWith('discipline-')){if(a.enemyType==='CinderImp')a.resumeBehavior();else if(a.enemyType==='FrostPuff')a.testClip=null;else a.resumePursuit();}}

buttons.label: Log target evidence
buttons.script: console.info('DISCIPLINE_EVIDENCE',JSON.stringify([...objects].filter(a=>a.definition?.id?.startsWith('discipline-')).map(a=>({id:a.definition.id,suppressed:a.grudgesSuppressed,target:(a.chooseTarget?.()??a.combat?.shotTarget??a.pursuitTarget)?.definition?.id,revenge:a.revengeTarget?.definition?.id,state:a.stateName,health:a.health}))));

buttons.label: Resume discipline
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { actor.testClip=null; } }

buttons.label: Bell (2s)
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { actor.onBellRung({eventId: Symbol(),duration:2}); } }

buttons.label: Hit / interrupt
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { actor.receiveDamage(1); } }

buttons.label: Stun (2s)
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { actor.applyStatus('stun',{duration:2}); } }

buttons.label: Carry by ally
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { const ally=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='mask-shaman-ally');actor.beginCarry(ally); } }

buttons.label: Throw (Ammo)
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { actor.launch({velocity:{x:-1,y:5,z:1}}); } }

buttons.label: Defeat
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { actor.receiveDamage(actor.health); } }

buttons.label: Verify all clips
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { void actor.checks.verifyClips(); } }

buttons.label: Save transparent preview
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { void actor.checks.preview(); } }

buttons.label: Half time
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { actor.app.timeScale=.5; } }

buttons.label: Normal time
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'mask-shaman-main') { actor.app.timeScale=1; } }

buttons.label: Verify behavior
buttons.script: for(const a of objects){if(a.definition?.id==='mask-shaman-main')void a.checks.verifyBehavior();}
